title: Advanced Engineer - Android framework
jobDescription:
Job Description Requirements Job Description Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career. Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment About the Role We are looking for an experienced Android Framework & HAL Developer with strong C++ Middleware expertise to join our automotive platform development team. The role focuses on developing and integrating Android components across Framework, HAL, and middleware layers for next-generation infotainment systems. What You Will Do Develop and maintain Android Framework components and system services Design and implement Android HAL modules using AIDL/HIDL Build and integrate C++ middleware components on Linux platforms Work on Binder IPC, JNI, and native system services Collaborate with BSP, kernel, and hardware teams for integration Optimize performance, memory, and boot time of Android platform Debug system issues using tools like adb, logcat, gdb, dmesg Work on SELinux policies and security adaptations Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD processes Collaborate in Agile teams for feature delivery and integration What You Need to Be Successful 3–6 years of experience in Android Framework / HAL / Middleware development Strong programming skills in C++ (mandatory) Hands-on experience with Android AOSP, Framework, and system services Experience in HAL implementation using AIDL/HIDL Good understanding of Android architecture (Framework → HAL → Kernel) Experience with IPC mechanisms (Binder, sockets, message queues) Exposure to JNI / NDK development Strong knowledge of Linux OS and embedded systems Experience in Android build system (Soong/Make/BP) Basic knowledge of Java/Kotlin Strong debugging and problem-solving skills Good to Have Experience in Android Automotive (AAOS) / Infotainment domain Exposure to VHAL, Audio, Camera, Connectivity HALs Experience with SELinux and Android security stack Knowledge of AUTOSAR / ISO 26262 standards Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, Agile methodologies Experience in device driver integration / BSP bring-up What Makes You Eligible Bachelor’s degree in CS / Electronics / related field 3–6 years of relevant Android platform experience Strong ownership and ability to work in cross-functional teams Experience in delivering production-grade embedded solutions What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Opportunities for professional growth and development
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment
- Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
- Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance through Be Brilliant
- Chance to work with a renowned German OEM
- You are expected to work all 5 days in a week in office About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected. Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other. If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today! Important Notice: Recruitment Scams Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘@harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your Linked In/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com. You Belong Here HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment About the Role We are looking for a high-impact AI/ML Engineer with up to 5-7 years of experience to build next-generation Automotive AI systems , aligned with HARMAN AES’s vision of agentic, cross-domain automotive intelligence . This role focuses on developing and deploying SLMs (Small Language Models), VLA/VLM models, and AI orchestration layers across edge and cloud environments , enabling intelligent cockpit, ADAS, and connected vehicle experiences. What You Will Do
1. AI/ML Model Development, Domain Specific Finetuning & Deployment Develop and optimize SLMs (Small Language Models) for: In-vehicle conversational AI Context-aware reasoning and intent handling Deploy model on Edge Device (CPU, NPU, GPU) Work with VLM/VLA models for: Scene understanding, multi-modal perception, and interaction Implement edge + cloud AI pipelines for real-time inference and hybrid execution
2. Agentic AI & Orchestration Systems Develop AI orchestration layers : Intent routing and tool routing Policy engines, scheduling, and coordination Cross-domain context management
3. Multi-Modal & Cross-Domain Intelligence Build systems integrating: Voice (ASR, TTS, NLU) Visual perception (VLM/VLA) Sensor fusion signals Enable cross-domain intelligence across cockpit, ADAS, and connected services
4. Data, MLOps Design ML pipelines and MLOps workflows : Model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring Ensure compliance with: Safety, cybersecurity, and automotive standards
5. Collaboration & Engineering Integration Work with: Embedded software teams Cloud/data engineering teams HMI and system integration teams Contribute to end-to-end automotive AI platforms and solutions Bonus Points if You Have Automotive domain exposure (ADAS, cockpit, connectivity) Speech AI (ASR, TTS, conversational systems) Knowledge of: AUTOSAR / embedded systems Vehicle data platforms Experience with: Simulation environments Digital twin / validation platforms Seamless integration of in-vehicle AI solutions End-to-end AI engine development on edge devices leveraging NPU, CPU, and GPU capabilities AI/ML model inference on edge devices using C++ APIs or NNAPI for optimized performance What Makes You Eligible Core AI/ML Strong experience in: Deep learning, NLP, and computer vision LLM/SLM fine-tuning and optimization Exposure to VLM/VLA or multi-modal AI models Agentic AI & Orchestration Hands-on experience with: AI agents / tool-using LLMs Orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Langgraph/Autogent/Semantic Kernel, custom pipelines) MCP Servers Edge + Cloud AI Experience deploying models on: Embedded / edge platforms Cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) Programming & Frameworks Python (mandatory), C++ (preferred) Py Torch / Tensor Flow API-based AI integration MLOps & Data Experience with: Model lifecycle management CI/CD pipelines Data pipelines What We Offer Access to employee discounts on world-class products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, and more) Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University Competitive wellness benefits Tuition reimbursement “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development

title: Associate Engineer - AI/ML with Python
jobDescription:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career. Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment About the Role We are seeking a highly enthusiastic Agentic AI Engineer with up to 1 year of experience, eager to work on next‑generation AI systems driven by autonomous agents and Large Language Models (LLMs). This role is ideal for fresh graduates or early‑career professionals passionate about AI, web technologies, and cloud‑native development, who want to build intelligent, scalable, and automated solutions. What You Will Do Design and develop Agentic AI workflows using LLMs, tools, planners, and memory components. Build and integrate LLM‑powered applications using frameworks such as Lang Chain and Llama Index . Develop RESTful APIs and backend services using Django, Flask, Fast API, Robyn Framework, or Vert.x . Implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and embeddings. Work on Machine Learning model development , including feature engineering and data preprocessing. Develop and maintain web applications and microservices with secure authentication (OAuth, JWT). Use Celery tasks for asynchronous processing and background AI workloads. Work with databases and search systems such as My SQL, Redis, Elastic Search, and Scylla DB. Containerize applications using Docker and support deployments on Kubernetes . Assist in model training, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployments on AWS. Collaborate in an agile team across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) . What You Need to Be Successful 3 to 6 year of experience (or strong academic/project exposure) in AI, ML, or Software Development . Programming knowledge in Python (mandatory); exposure to Go Lang, Java, SQL, Java Script is a plus. Understanding of HTML, CSS , and modern web application architecture. Familiarity with Machine Learning fundamentals and common ML algorithms. Hands-on exposure to ML libraries: Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Scikit‑learn, Pandas, Num Py . Basic understanding of NLP, Transformers, and Large Language Models (Open AI, LLa MA) . Knowledge of RESTful APIs , JSON , and SQLAlchemy . Experience (academic or project-based) with Git, Git Hub or Bitbucket . Awareness of CI/CD pipelines , build processes, and software deployment concepts. Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving mindset. Bonus Points If You Have Practical experience with Agentic AI concepts (tools, reasoning, planning, memory). Hands-on projects using Hugging Face , Lang Chain , or Llama Index . Exposure to RAG architectures and vector databases. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Kibana . Familiarity with AWS services for application or ML deployment. Internship or academic project experience in AI/ML or Full‑Stack Development . Open‑source contributions or personal Git Hub projects. What Makes You Eligible Bachelor’s degree (or final‑year student) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related field . Strong foundation in programming, data structures, and software engineering basics . Passion for AI, autonomous systems, and emerging technologies . Ability to learn quickly and work effectively in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment . What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Opportunities for professional growth and development
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment
- Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
- Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance through Be Brilliant
- Chance to work with a renowned German OEM

What You Will Do
1. Middleware Development: Design, develop, and maintain middleware solutions using C++ on Linux platforms, ensuring high performance and reliability.
2. System Integration: Integrate middleware components with other system components, ensuring seamless functionality and optimal performance.
3. Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize middleware performance, ensuring low latency and high throughput.
4. Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve complex issues related to middleware functionality and performance.
5. Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance and support to junior team members, sharing knowledge and expertise. What You Need to Be Successful
1. Technical Skills:
- Proficiency in C++ programming language (C++11/C++14/C++17)
- Experience with Linux operating system and development environment
- Knowledge of middleware technologies (e.g., D-Bus, IPC, message queues)
2. Development Experience:
- 3-6 years of experience in developing and maintaining complex middleware solutions
- Understanding of system integration, testing, and validation
3. Problem-Solving Skills:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to debug complex issues using tools like gdb Bonus Points if You Have
1. Experience with Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban)
2. Knowledge of Networking Protocols: Understanding of networking protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, HTTP, MQTT)
3. Experience with Version Control Systems: Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git, SVN)
4. Experience with Cloud Technologies: Knowledge of cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
5. Familiarity with Dev Ops Tools: Experience with Dev Ops tools (e.g., Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) What Makes You Eligible
1. Relevant Experience: 3-6 years of experience in C++ Linux middleware development
2. Technical Expertise: Strong technical skills in C++, Linux, and middleware development
3. Problem-Solving Abilities: Ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues
4. Leadership Skills: Ability to provide technical guidance and support to junior team members What We Offer

title: Principal Engineer- Android Framework
jobDescription: As a Senior Android Automotive HMI Developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and integrating next-generation Human Machine Interface (HMI) solutions for Android Automotive OS (AAOS) based infotainment systems. You will collaborate closely with UX designers, system architects, OEM customers, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver intuitive, scalable, and high-performance in-vehicle user experiences. This is a highly technical individual contributor role requiring strong expertise in Android application development, automotive frameworks, and modern UI technologies. What You Will Do Design, develop, and maintain Android Automotive HMI applications for Infotainment, Navigation, Media, Vehicle Settings, Climate Control, and Connected Services. Lead the development of scalable and reusable HMI software architectures aligned with OEM requirements and Android Automotive best practices. Develop user interfaces using Android SDK, Jetpack components, MVVM architecture, and modern UI frameworks such as Jetpack Compose. Integrate applications with Android Automotive platform services, Vehicle HAL (VHAL), Car Service APIs, and middleware components. Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts, wireframes, and prototypes into production-quality software. Optimize application performance, startup time, memory utilization, and responsiveness for embedded automotive platforms. Work closely with platform, BSP, middleware, validation, and integration teams to ensure seamless feature delivery. Participate in software design reviews, code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical mentoring of junior developers. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, framework, and vehicle integration layers. Ensure compliance with automotive quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and OEM development processes. Support software releases, customer demonstrations, integration activities, and field issue investigations. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, development best practices, and technical innovation within the organization. What You Need to Be Successful Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Electronics, Embedded Systems, or a related engineering discipline. 8 -12 years of experience in Android application development, including significant experience in Android Automotive OS. Strong proficiency in Java and Kotlin programming languages. Deep understanding of Android Framework, Android Architecture Components, and application lifecycle management. Hands-on experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS), Car APIs, Vehicle HAL (VHAL), and Vehicle Property integrations. Experience in developing HMI applications for IVI (In-Vehicle Infotainment) systems. Expertise in MVVM, Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection (Dagger/Hilt), and modern software design patterns. Strong knowledge of Jetpack Compose and traditional Android UI development methodologies. Experience with Android build systems including Gradle, Android Studio, Gerrit, and CI/CD pipelines. Good understanding of Linux-based embedded systems and software debugging techniques. Strong experience with performance optimization, memory analysis, profiling, and troubleshooting. Familiarity with software development lifecycle processes, Agile methodologies, and automotive product development. Knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, and vehicle diagnostics concepts. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Bonus Points if You Have Master’s degree in computer science, Automotive Software Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience working with leading automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. Hands-on experience with Android Automotive customization, System UI, Launcher, and Settings applications. Knowledge of Google Automotive Services (GAS) integration and certification processes. Experience with Qualcomm, NXP, Renesas, or similar automotive So C platforms. Familiarity with Automotive SPICE (ASPICE), Functional Safety (ISO 26262), and Cybersecurity (ISO 21434). Experience with vehicle diagnostics, OTA updates, and connected vehicle services. Exposure to cloud-connected automotive ecosystems and telematics solutions. Contributions to Android Open Source Project (AOSP) or open-source software communities. Experience leading technical teams, mentoring developers, and driving architectural initiatives. What Makes You Eligible Ability to work from HARMAN development centers or customer locations as required. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for customer engagements, workshops, and project milestones. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones. Flexibility to support critical program activities and customer deliverables outside regular business hours when necessary. Eligibility to work in the country of employment and comply with customer-specific security and access requirements. Ability to participate in onsite integration, testing, and vehicle validation activities when required

title: Software Engineer - CarPlay
jobDescription:
About HARMAN: HARMAN Connected Services is a global leader in connected car technology, lifestyle audio innovations, design and analytics, cloud services, and Io T solutions. We pride ourselves on our innovative culture, where you can collaborate with talented professionals, drive innovation, and develop cutting-edge solutions. At HARMAN, you'll work on a diverse range of projects spanning automotive, audio, Io T, and cloud services. With offices in over 30 countries, we offer a truly global presence and are committed to your professional growth. Our competitive benefits package includes comprehensive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and recognition programs. Join our dynamic, inclusive, and supportive work environment to shape the future of automotive technology. Job Summary: The Senior Software Engineer (3-6 years’ experience) will design, develop, and integrate Apple Car Play features within Android-based infotainment platforms. This role focuses on strong individual technical contribution, system-level development, and mentoring junior engineers, while working under architectural guidance from technical leads.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and integrate Apple Car Play functionality within Android Automotive OS–based infotainment systems. Implement and maintain Car Play connection lifecycle features including connection, projection, audio playback, Alternate screen support, enhanced siri and error recovery. Implement and enhance Binder / AIDL-based IPC for Car Play projection services. Develop and maintain state machines and service lifecycle logic for reliable Car Play operation. Work across Android framework, native components to support Car Play projection flows. Perform system-level debugging of crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, performance bottlenecks, and boot-time issues. Use debugging and profiling tools such as ADB, logcat, Perfetto, and Android Studio Profiler. Apply JNI and native debugging skills to diagnose and fix cross-layer issues. Support Apple Car Play certification activities by analyzing validation failures and implementing corrective fixes. Collaborate with QA, certification, and platform teams to ensure Car Play stability and compliance. Stay informed about updates to Car Play specifications, i OS compatibility, and Android Automotive platform changes. Required Skills & Experience: Programming Skills: Kotlin, Java, C++ Strong experience in Android system-level development (AAOS or AOSP). Solid understanding of Android services, Binder / AIDL, and system service lifecycles. Experience with projection technologies (Apple Car Play). Proficiency in JNI. Hands-on experience debugging complex Android system issues. Familiarity with Apple Car Play specifications and certification process is a strong plus. Understanding of Carplay communication plugin Knowledge of FACET testing. Proficiency in ATS log analysis. Strong experience in Audio related Carplay certification test cases. Preferred skill:
1. Knowledge of Bluetooth, USB, Wifi and other automotive connectivity protocols.
2. Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git or SVN.
3. Experience of minimum 1 complete Carplay certification What We Offer:
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Opportunities for professional growth and development
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment
- Flexible working hours and work-from-home options
- Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
- Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance
- Chance to work with a renowned German OEM

title: Staff Manager - External Reporting
jobDescription:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award-winning success. Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy Augment your comprehensive skillset with expert training across decision-making, change management, leadership, and business development Obtain 360-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early-stage to seasoned leader About the Role As Senior Manager
- External Reporting, you will partner with Finance leadership to set up, centralize, and stabilize external reporting through the India Finance Capability Center (FCC). This is a leadership role responsible for designing the target operating model, transitioning reporting activities into the FCC, and leading the preparation and review of statutory financial statements, disclosures, schedules, and audit support for assigned legal entities. The role will act as a subject matter expert on applicable accounting standards and reporting policies, ensure strong controls and audit readiness, and build a scalable team capable of delivering accurate, timely, and compliant external reporting. What You Will Do Partner with the hiring manager and global/regional finance leaders to design and operationalize the external and statutory reporting capability within the FCC. Define the service catalogue, transition scope, target operating model, team structure, RACI, governance calendar, SLAs, KPIs, escalation protocols, and management reporting routines. Support end-to-end transition and centralization of external reporting activities, including knowledge transfer, process documentation, shadow/support phases, readiness assessment, stabilization, and post-transition improvements. Oversee preparation and review of statutory financial statements, notes to accounts, disclosure checklists, financial reporting packages, board/audit committee schedules, and local filing support for assigned legal entities. Ensure reporting outputs comply with IFRS, K-IFRS, local GAAP, group accounting policies, and internal reporting requirements; prepare/review accounting position papers for complex matters where required. Own close-to-report deliverables supporting external reporting, including trial balance reviews, flux analysis, reconciliations, intercompany positions, consolidation inputs, and audit schedules. Build robust controls over reporting outputs, including maker-checker reviews, segregation of duties, version control, approval governance, evidence retention, audit trails, and issue remediation. Coordinate with statutory auditors, group auditors, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Controlling, Business Units, Procurement, Logistics, IT, banks, affiliates, and global finance stakeholders to ensure timely audit and reporting completion. Build and maintain SOPs, process maps, RACI matrices, control checklists, close calendars, disclosure templates, and knowledge repositories to ensure continuity and scalability. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop the FCC reporting team; set performance expectations, build technical capability, and drive a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and digitize reporting processes using SAP, reporting tools, and process excellence methods. What You Need to Be Successful Qualified Chartered Accountant, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent finance professional; MBA Finance may be considered where supported by strong external reporting and statutory financial statements experience. 10-15 years of progressive experience in controllership, external reporting, statutory reporting, audit, shared services, or finance capability center environments, preferably in a multinational organization. Demonstrated prior experience setting up, transitioning, or materially stabilizing an external reporting/statutory reporting Co E or shared services tower; greenfield or build-out exposure is strongly preferred. Hands-on experience preparing and/or reviewing statutory financial statements, notes/disclosures, reporting packs, disclosure checklists, audit schedules, and financial statement support files for multiple legal entities. Strong technical accounting knowledge of IFRS, K-IFRS, local GAAP, and group accounting policies, with ability to assess accounting/reporting implications and communicate them clearly. Strong understanding of month-end/year-end close, general ledger controls, reconciliations, intercompany, consolidation inputs, flux analysis, and audit readiness. Experience working with SAP and reporting/close tools such as Workiva, One Source, One Stream, Black Line, Power BI, or equivalent platforms. Proven ability to design operating metrics, governance routines, control frameworks, SOPs, and process documentation for scalable reporting operations. Strong people leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior finance stakeholders, auditors, regional controllers, and cross-functional partners. Experience driving transformation, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement in a complex global finance environment. Bonus Points if You Have Experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or automotive supplier industry. Big 4/statutory audit experience followed by industry controllership or reporting experience. Experience with ESG reporting, XBRL/i XBRL, or listed-company-style external reporting processes. Project management, Lean/Six Sigma, transition methodology, or finance transformation experience. What Makes You Eligible Willingness to work from the Bangalore office and partner across global time zones as required. Ability to support critical close, statutory reporting, and audit deadlines during peak reporting periods. What We Offer HARMAN Flex Connect Program, offering a flexible hybrid work environment that fosters stronger collaboration, meaningful connections, and innovation through a minimum of three in-office days per week. title: T3(B) – Advance Engineer – Android Framework Developer
jobDescription: Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career. • Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience • Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence • Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment About the Role As a Advance Engineer, you will be responsible for Developing, Unit Testing, Component Testing, Prepare LLD/Design Documents, Bug fixing, interfacing with internal and external stakeholders of HARMAN. What You Will Do • Android native Framework and Native development and customizations, In-vehicle/automotive Infotainment Platforms • Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in C/C++ and Java/Kotlin, with strong knowledge of the Java Native Interface (JNI) to bridge native and framework layers. AOSP & Architecture: In-depth understanding of Android architecture, including System Services, Audio, Camera, Connectivity (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth), and Graphics stacks System Programming: Deep experience with Binder IPC, AIDL (Android Interface Definition Language), and Service Managers HAL Development: Hands-on experience creating or modifying Hardware Abstraction Layers, Treble/HIDL, and interfacing directly with Linux kernel drivers. Build Systems & Toolchains: Familiarity with the Android Build System (Soong/Kati), Makefiles, and tools like Yocto, especially when dealing with Board Support Packages (BSP) Testing & Debugging: Proficiency in AOSP testing suites like CTS (Compatibility Test Suite), VTS (Vendor Test Suite), and performance profiling with Systrace/Perfettognition. What You Need to Be Successful •5-8 years of experience on embedded systems, with focus on Android Framework and Native development. Proficient of using Android Automotive Development, Test tools(Git/Gerrit, Gitlab, Jenkins, EA, Android Studio, VS code, CAN, Diaglyzer, CANoe, Valgrind, GTEST, Gmock, JUNIT, Jacoco, Coverity, etc) • Strong Java/kotlin, C++ programming skills experience. • Understanding of Android Boot Sequence and various Framework module architecture. • Proficient in Android System concepts. • Should have experience on Android development and debugging robust systems • Proficient in multi threaded programming and middleware solution development on Android environment. Strong in fundamentals of IPC and OS concepts. • Good experience in Android internals • System level debugging • Experience Binder framework and networking framework • Excellent in C++, design patterns, Android SDK, Android NDK, Java is added advantage • Experience on Android HIDL interfaces implementation and customizations • Android CTS and VTS debugging and issue fixing • Interface with Various Domains within Android Product Line to achieve Stability metrics. Bonus Points if You Have • Prior Android Automotive experience preferably in Cockpit(Infotainment Domain) • Prior Experience of working with Tier1- Automotive Supplier, OEMs. What Makes You Eligible • Work from Office, preferably for Bangalore based candidates. • Good Communication skills, added advantage of additional foreign language(French,German,etc) • Willingness to travel when necessary. • Due to the nature of global infrastructure, you understand that flexibility in working hours is required. What We Offer • Access to employee discounts on world-class products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, and more) • Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University • Competitive wellness benefits • Tuition reimbursement • “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program • An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development

title: Advanced Engineer - Requirement Engineering
jobDescription:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-tracking your career. Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience. Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence. Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment. About the Role As a Requirements Engineer for the Automotive Audio Innovations Team, you will serve as the critical bridge between product strategy, system architecture, and agile execution. Operating within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) ecosystem, you will collaborate with multiple Scrum teams specializing in Audio Innovations, Brand Applications, UX, Reference Platforms, and Cross-Team Core Features. Your core mission is to transform high-level Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and Customer Requirement Specifications (CRS) from tools like Aha! into highly structured, traceable System (SRS) and Technical (TRS) Requirements within IBM DNG, seamlessly mapping them to actionable Features and Modules in ALM. What You Will Do Requirement Elicitation & Synthesis Deconstruct Strategy: Analyze PRDs and high-level roadmap definitions within Aha! to extract the foundational Customer Requirement Specifications (CRS). Architectural Collaboration: Sit with System Architects, Product Managers, and Brand Owners to co-create, refine, and lock down the CRS, SRS, and TRS. Structure & Attributation: Author comprehensive System Requirements Specifications (SRS) and Technical Requirements Specifications (TRS). Define crisp, data-driven requirement attributes and metadata within the requirement modules. SAFe Alignment & ALM Feature Mapping Cross-Team Governance: Support a host of SAFe Scrum teams across various domains (UX, Audio Matrix, Brand Tuning, Reference Platforms) to ensure cross-functional alignment on complex, cross-team features. ALM Feature Ingestion: Map SRS/TRS documents directly to actionable Features and Design Requests within ALM Modules. Grooming & Clarity: Lead requirement and feature grooming sessions with Scrum teams, ensuring engineering backlogs are technically robust and unambiguous. Define Quality Gates: Collaborate with stakeholders to establish and document a stringent Definition of Done (Do D) within the DNG tool for flawless feature delivery. End-to-End Traceability & Quality Assurance Traceability Matrix: Establish, track, and maintain End-to-End (E2E) digital traceability: [Aha! / PRD] ↔ [DNG (SRS/TRS)] ↔ [ALM Features/Modules]. Validation Loop: Collaborate with the testing organization to ensure watertight traceability of test cases from ALM QLM back to the baseline SRS and TRS in DNG. User Acceptance: Participate in and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) gates before feature/product release to ensure execution matches the original design intent. What You Need to Be Successful Domain Expertise Automotive Systems: Solid engineering experience in the automotive domain as a Requirements or System Engineer. Audio & Infotainment Inflection: Hands-on experience or deep technical understanding of features including: Audio Sources & Routing, Tuner & Media playback, Vehicle Interfaces (CAN/LIN), Entertainment Systems, Bluetooth Connectivity, UI/UX interaction, and Cybersecurity. Tools & Systems Requirements Management: Advanced proficiency in IBM DOORS / DOORS Next Generation (DNG) for requirement import, module structuring, scrubbing, and configuration management. Agile & Lifecycle Management: Hands-on experience with ALM (Application Lifecycle Management), ALM QLM, Jira, and Confluence. Product Roadmapping: Familiarity with Aha! or similar product management platforms. Visualizing Requirements: Experience using tools like Gliffy, Visio, or Miro to build block/flow diagrams that communicate complex system interactions. Soft Skills & Methodology Scaled Agile: Clear understanding of SAFe methodologies, including working across multiple parallel Scrum teams, participating in PI Planning, and managing cross-team feature dependencies. Systems Thinking: Ability to translate abstract, design-heavy UX ideas or complex audio algorithms into structured, testable engineering requirements. Bonus Points if You Have Technical Leadership: The ability to guide engineering teams technically and anchor deep-dive architecture debates. AI-Driven Productivity: Experience utilizing AI tools/LLMs to accelerate requirement drafting, automate parsing, or enhance compliance/cleansing of SRS/TRS documentation. UI/UX Exposure: Prior experience or familiarity with UI design principles and wireframing/design prototyping tools. What Makes You Eligible Be willing to travel up to 20%, domestic or international. What We Offer HARMAN Flex Connect Program, offering a flexible hybrid work environment that fosters stronger collaboration, meaningful connections, and innovation through a minimum of three in-office days per week. Access to employee discounts on world-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc). Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University. Competitive wellness benefits. Tuition Reimbursement. Access to HARMAN Campus Fitness Center and Cafeteria. An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development. #LI-ST1 Requirement Engineering

Deconstruct Strategy: Analyze PRDs and high-level roadmap definitions within Aha! to extract the foundational Customer Requirement Specifications (CRS).

title: Principal Architect – Automotive Data Architecture
jobDescription: Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career. Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment About the Role As an Embedded Automotive Data Architect, you will design and lead the in-vehicle data collection architecture that enables continuous improvement and personalization of in-vehicle audio experiences, while ensuring a secure, privacy-preserving approach. You will partner closely with ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and Intelligent Cockpit engineers to define and roll out an end-to-end architecture that supports OTA delivery of edge AI/ML model updates, fully aligned with OEM specifications, constraints, and requirements. You will bridge collaboration with Intelligent Cockpit and Central Compute (HU/CCU) development teams to expand logging, telemetry, and communication mechanisms to capture and export audio system related interactions events and user preference data to enable continuous improvement of machine learning models and next-generation audio features. What You Will Do Partner with Intelligent Cockpit and Central Compute (HU/CCU), Data Engineer and ML to design and roll out architecture for data collection and models updates. Identify HMI/UX interaction and communication messages in HU/CCU/Amplifier to reliably capture how users interact with audio features. Identify logging mechanisms and storage allocation on HU/CCU/Amplifier to store relevant audio system related interactions and user preferences. Define retention, compression, and resource budgeting (CPU/RAM/flash) for new messages and signals about audio features usage and user preferences Architect data upload mechanisms, both on board and by cellphone gateways, under real constraints: connectivity availability, restrictions, cost/bandwidth budgets, OEM policies, intermittent coverage, and offline-first behavior; implement batching, sampling, retry/acknowledgement for data Collection retrieval. Identify and establish secure OTA workflows to update ML models considering versioning, integrity checks, rollout and rollback strategies, and compatibility rules. Advise in-vehicle OS integration approach across HU/CCU platforms (Linux, Android Automotive, QNX, and other OEM stacks) about logging frameworks, networking messaging and UDS. Select and advise on vehicle networking messages (CAN / Automotive Ethernet, etc.) to safely consume necessary signals and create correlation with Audio systems events. Advise on privacy mechanisms including data minimization, anonymization, retention and deletion rules for data collection Advise on consent-aware data collection, retention and deletion strategies according to privacy standards and OEM practices. Partner with Data/ML/DSP teams to ensure the vehicle-side data architecture cleanly connects to cloud pipelines for training, evaluation, and continuous improvement of edge experiences. What You Need to Be Successful 12+ years of experience in automotive embedded software or systems engineering, with architecture ownership in at least one of: Head Unit/Infotainment, Cockpit/Domain Controller, Telematics/Connectivity, or Vehicle Data/Diagnostics. Experience designing telemetry/logging systems under constrained compute/memory/storage, including reliability strategies (buffering, persistence, loss management). Experience with OTA update architectures (software/component delivery), including artifact versioning, signing/integrity, staged rollout, rollback, and compatibility management. Working knowledge of HU/CCU operating systems (Linux, Android Automotive, QNX, or similar), including debugging/log analysis, process/service design, and performance constraints. Solid knowledge of automotive networking and integration constraints: CAN, Automotive Ethernet, UDS and ODB-II and ability to collaborate with cybersecurity stakeholders. Strong communication, collaboration and leadership skills to influence cross-functional stakeholders and standardize practices across teams. Strong structured mindset with the ability to design complex and robust systems while keeping optimal and clean architecture Bonus Points if You Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or Computer Science (or closely related field). Experience with SDV and zonal vehicle architecture Experience with Android Automotive, QNX, embedded Linux distributions used in cockpit systems, or OEM-specific stacks. Familiarity with common automotive diagnostics patterns and tools (e.g., DTC workflows, log/trace pipelines). Background in infotainment/audio feature delivery, real-time constraints, or resource budgeting for DSP/So C platforms. Exposure to cybersecurity and automotive standards contexts (e.g., ISO 21434) and/or process frameworks (ASPICE), even if not the owner. Understanding of privacy and security fundamentals for connected data systems (data minimization, consent, pseudonymization, encryption, secure communications) What Makes You Eligible Advanced English communication skill, will be part of a Global team Willing to work in an office at Bangalore. What We Offer HARMAN Flex Connect Program, offering a flexible hybrid work environment that fosters stronger collaboration, meaningful connections, and innovation through a minimum of three in-office days per week. Access to employee discounts on world-class products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, and more) Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University Competitive wellness benefits Tuition reimbursement “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development. #LI-AR2
